```dafny
  requires 1 <= M;

  var y := X[1-1,1-1];
  var a := 1;
  while (a != M)

    var b := a + 1;
    while (b != M+1)

        c := c - 1;
      }
      b := b + 1;
    }
    a := a + 1;
    y := y * X[a-1,a-1];
  }
  z := y;
}
```
